description: The North Cyprus car rental price list (Kıbrıs araç kiralama fiyatları), without dates: daily rates per car class and rental length, add-on prices and one-time pickup or return fees, with insurance and VAT included. With a currency, amounts are also given in it as *_quoted.

category.description: Optional car class. Omit for every class.

currency.description: Also price in this currency (*_quoted amounts).
